title: Recover turns without duplicate actors
description:
Purpose: make at-least-once queue delivery and worker failure safe before any tool can act.

Definition of Done:
- One logical turn has at most one active attempt with authority to write or act.
- Queue redelivery cannot create a second model actor or duplicate answer.
- A dead attempt is continued from durable state or reaches a visible terminal state within a bounded deadline.
- A stale attempt is fenced from later writes and actions.
- Ambiguous external-call outcomes are surfaced for reconciliation rather than blindly repeated.
- Fault-injection specifications cover every persistence, queue, and model boundary.

comments.author: home
comments.text: DoD met on develop: one fenced attempt (19eddc/3eb727), duplicate delivery (a7ef19), interrupted recovery (b821ea), EventBridge handoff (e42008 live on development ThinTurn), ambiguous provider reconciliation (turn_recovery.feature), fault injection (83b5e3). Not promoting extra computer kernels to main. No staging/production.
